value.mode_entry: Explicit begin from current immutable owner revision; read-only supported design only. Detached mock map seeded from declared safe props or neutral values; no content write. Consumer is bound to actual window instance/preview UUID.
value.supported_schema: H2 supports Form/Button/CheckBox/TextBox/NumberInput/ComboBox only for mock capability. Button props permitted activation only. ComboBox items must be array of closed {id:string,label:string}, unique nonempty IDs; absent/unsupported items -> UnsupportedAction, not labels-as-identity. Scope must be absent or ui; unknown/non-ui scope disables mock capabilities without changing source. uiExclusive is data, never grants authority.

matrix.effect: set detached text, render via textContent
C1 exact numeric guard, set detached canonical numeric value; never JS float proof
only declared stable item ID from immutable supported items schema

value.sequence: Start expected_seq=1, increment checked once only on accepted mock action. Reject wrong/stale/invalid payload without consuming sequence. u64 max cannot be incremented -> SequenceOverflow and close preview, no partial update. Accepted action replay with old seq -> SequenceConflict; no second effect.
value.payload_rules: Action determines exact oneOf payload variant: Activate {},SetToggle checked,SetText text,SetNumber number_text,SelectItem item_id. Reject extra fields, mismatch, arbitrary command/eval/url/file/target paths.
value.permissions: Viewer capability allows only binding_get, viewer_begin/intent/refresh/close; never candidate/edit/undo/save/transfer or general dispatch/host-default. Viewer mock actions cannot call Tauri invoke by action string.
value.refresh: Build temporary supported projection from current owner snapshot after explicit refresh request. Revalidate generation/revision/consumer, replace only on success, new preview UUID and sequence1; retire old preview. Failure leaves previous mock projection visibly stale, cannot act until valid refresh.
value.revocation: Content revision, writer generation, project/document close, navigation/reload/destroy revokes affected preview; mock values discarded. No late response installs against different owner.
value.materials: No file/network/image loading as mock effect. If immutable content references unresolved material/binding, show inert placeholder and disable dependent action with MissingMaterial/MissingBindingTarget. No fake media substitute or execution.

roles.MissingBinding: show bind/adopt explanation, disable all content actions, no guessed UUID or raw root

contracts: write_new只能create_new，不覆寫stage內同名檔；以ASCII casefold檢查碰撞，拒reparse/hardlink和穿越。

reader不得寫入或清journal；private共享coordination檢查沿用已確認IO v1終態，不另改FileCommit公開trait。

value.rule: GenerationReadLease在同一active側檔取得OS共享read handle；與FileCommit exclusive writer互斥，允許多reader。側檔必須已存在，reader不create、不寫。取得後唯讀檢查IO journal：PREPARED/未知/損毀/RecoveryRequired拒絕，合法terminal需與active bytes一致。缺協調檔/未Ready namespace拒絕，不假稱已初始化。
value.lifetime: HOST持read lease到active/manifest解析、所有檔hash與完整性驗證及byte snapshot複製完成才釋放。M03接收此不可變byte snapshot，不再直接讀活動檔案。writer不得在持read lease時重入；同一用例鎖順序為namespace bootstrap（若必要，先完成並釋放）→active writer或reader二選一→stage handle。

pointers.text: **回滾**：健康變紅或超出錯誤預算時，先關 Feature Flag；不夠就把 updater manifest／部署指回 `rollbackRef`，再 `git revert`。卡片設為 Rolled Back（紅燈），補備註寫原因，之後開新的 Patch 修正。

**佈署卡（看板 level = Deployment）**：欄位有 `version`、`releaseType`（Major/Minor/Patch/Hotfix/RC）、`environment`、`strategy`（Direct/Canary/Gradual/FeatureFlag）、`rolloutPercent`、`featureFlags`、`includes`（Task/Story/PR）、`gitRef`、`commitSha`、`changelogUrl`、`buildUrl`、`healthChecks`、`rollbackPla
1. **先量測**：用 `cargo bench` / criterion、`cargo flamegraph`、Chrome DevTools Performance 找出真正的瓶頸，記下基準數字。沒有量測數據就不做優化。
- **執行指令前**：擋下危險指令（`rm -rf /`、`git push --force`、`git reset --hard`、`format`、`del /s`、`curl … | sh`、讀 `.env`），推送、遞迴刪除、發布套件等高風險指令要使用者確認。

- **版本與佈署檢查**（與上面各項一起做）：PR 標題／commit 符合 Conventional Commits；若這次要發版，版本號升級符合 SemVer 且三個版本檔一致、CHANGELOG 有對應條目；佈署卡的 `releaseType` 與升版一致、Prod 卡有 `rollbackPlan` 與非開發代理的 `approvedBy`；Hotfix 有重現 Bug 的測試並已規劃 back-merge。不符就退回。
- 有寫好的回滾計畫：先關哪個 Feature Flag、回到哪個版本（`rollbackRef`）、誰執行；資料庫 migration 必須向下相容或有反向 migration。

seal失敗消耗handle後只關閉資源，錯誤必回保留路徑；已seal版本不由abort/Drop刪除。
verify_sealed檢查fixed manifest raw hash與HOST已驗證投影、所有檔的真實bytes/hash、沒有多餘/缺失/被修改檔；不以marker存在代替驗證。
reader不得寫入或清journal；private共享coordination檢查沿用已確認IO v1終態，不另改FileCommit公開trait。
只讀marker與固定metadata，無合法marker之既有namespace一律拒絕；不遞迴刪使用者專案。
verify_sealed屬read lease自身方法，root/project及協調handle由lease私有持有；caller不能用任意DTO取代guard。回傳完整bounded bytes snapshot後才可釋放。HOST只解析metadata，codec不持有OS handle。
